selection.reason: resetGame contains the level generation logic where we can reduce the number of walls. update contains the camera tracking logic where we can adjust the camera's distance to the avatar.

patch.notes: Reduced the spawn probability of buildings from 100% to 30% per grid cell to make the environment less cramped with walls. Also adjusted the initial and target camera positions (`targetCamZ` from `+12` to `+5` and `targetCamY` from `+6` to `+4`) to bring the camera significantly closer to the player's avatar.
